sentences.text:
Notice of aforesaid Reference was issued to the Workman and after service of said notice,
Statement of Claim was filed by him.

The brief facts as stated in his Statement of Claim are as follows:
1. That the Workman was working with the Management as Driver since 10.07.2012 and his last drawn salary was Rs.11,830/-.
2. That the Management had not provided him the legal facilities viz.
appointment letter, identity card, weekly and festival off, overtime, salary slip, etc. and when he raised demand for said facilities, the Management got annoyed at him and illegally terminated his services w.e.f. 17.10.2017 without giving him any Show-cause Notice and without conducting domestic enquiry.
His wages for the period 01.10.2017 to 16.10.2017 were also not paid.

3. That Demand Notice was sent by workman to the Management but despite service of notice,
neither Management sent any reply to said notice nor paid him earned wages nor reinstated him.
4. That a complaint was made to Assistant Labour Commissioner through the Union but management refused reinstate the workman.
5. That the workman is completely unemployed since the day of his illegal termination and depend upon his family and could not secure any employment despite efforts made by him.
3. Thereafter, notice of Statement of Claim was issued to Management and Management filed its Written Statement.

In the Written Statement, the management raised following defences:
1. That the workman was dismissed from services vide letter dated 10.02.2018 after holding a domestic inquiry.
2. That the inquiry was conducted as per the rules of principle of natural justice,
where it was found that the workman was absent without leave and participated in illegal Dharna Pradarshan on 16.10.2017 and 17.10.2017 at the office of the management B-26, Okhla Industrial Area, New Delhi.
3.
That during the said Dharna, the workman alongwith others had also forcibly entered the gate and surrendered the cash vault.
Further, the other workmen who were carrying out their duties were abused and restrained from performing their duties.
The tyres of the cash vehicles were deflated and the management was abused in filthy language.
Some workmen performing their duties were also beaten.
4. That the workman refused to participate in the domestic inquiry despite service of notices.

sentences.text: On 13.03.2020, following issue was framed in the present case by my Ld.
Predecessor:
1. Whether the enquiry so conducted by the management has followed principles of natural justice or not?
OPP 5.
The management was asked to lead evidence first.
The management produced one Surya Deo Kushwaha, the Enquiry Officer as its witness.

The said witness MW-1 exhibited chargesheet dated 29.12.2017 as Ex.MW1/1, enquiry proceedings as Ex.MW1/2 and Enquiry Report as Ex.MW1/3.
6.
Although, represented by proxy AR/counsel on 30.05.2023, MW-1 was not cross examined despite opportunity.
My Ld. Predecessor therefore, discharged the witness with cross examination as "Nil.
Opportunity given".
Therefore, even though, the witness was available for cross examination, the workman did not cross examine the witness and allowed the opportunity to lapse.
The management closed its evidence on 17.08.2023 vide separate statement.
7. The workman failed to produce any affirmative evidence despite opportunity.
Today also none appeared on behalf of the workman.
Therefore, the right of the workman to lead evidence was closed vide separate order.
8. Final arguments were heard on behalf of the management and the record was perused.
9. It can be said that in the absence of any cross examination the evidence of the management witness has gone unrebutted.
There seem to be no impediment in relying upon the documents produced by the management witness in evidence, as also, the oral testimony of the witness.
10. On the basis of the testimony of the sole witness MW-1, it stands established that management has sent the chargesheet on the address of workman available with them.

So, in these circumstances,
presumption of service of workman of charge sheet on given address exists as per General Clauses Act.

It has already come on record that publication was got effected in daily newspaper and the workman had information about the domestic inquiry but for the reasons best known to him, he did not appear in inquiry proceedings and management had no option but to proceed further as per law.
11. No fault can be found in the inquiry conducted by the management.

The contents of the inquiry report reveal that workman forcibly entered inside the gate and surrounded around the cash vault which is very highly sensitive area as crores of rupees of public money was stored there but he did not care about the same and he was bent upon disturbing the industrial peace and harmony in the organization.

12. From facts of the present case and the evidence led before this court, it is clear that the workman alongwith other employees held illegal dharnas, pradarshan, shouting slogans against the management and the workman with outside anti- social elements shouted slogans at branch and head office of management.
Not only this but they forcibly entered inside the gate and surrounded around the cash vault which is very highly sensitive area and created ruckus.

sentences.text: It is also come on record that workman deflated the cash vehicles standing outside the office at parking and caused destruction of vehicles and property of management and workman was bent upon disturbing the industrial peace and harmony in the organization.
It has come on record that against the illegal actions of workman, the management approached the Hon'ble Court and Hon'ble Court was pleased to issue interim injunction against the workman.

However, despite the orders of Hon'ble Court, the workman with his close associates continued to cause obstruction in the working of management and mercilessly beaten the gunman namely Sh. Dorilal who lodged his complaint vide DD No. 45A, DD No. 22B dated 17.10.2017, DD No. 42B, dated 01.11.2017, U/s: 323 IPC dated 02.11.2017, PS-Okhla.
14.

From above discussion, it is clear that workman has committed a serious misconduct and rather,
he did not submit any explanation to the charge sheet and finding no alternate, management took decision to constitute a domestic inquiry on the charges levelled against the workman.

It has come on record that Enquiry Officer Sh. S.D. Kushwaha was appointed to hold the enquiry and notices were sent to the workman to participate in the enquiry proceedings but the workman did not participate in the enquiry proceedings and thereafter, publication was made in the Hindi newspaper namely 'National Express' but none of the workmen including the present workman appeared on fixed date.

The perusal of inquiry report shows that workman was found guilty in the enquiry report which was conducted in accordance with the principles of natural justice and fair opportunity was given to the workman.

Relief:
15. In view of the above observations, the present claim is rejected.
Reference is answered in above terms.

16. A copy of this award be sent to the Deputy Labour Commissioner, Government of NCT of Delhi of District/Area concerned for publication as per rules and judicial file be consigned to Record Room as per rules.
Digitally signed Harjyot by Harjyot Singh Bhalla Singh
